name: Overdue Books Report
query:
SELECT 
            t.name as `Transaction ID:Link/Library Transaction:120`, 
            t.article as `Book Name`, 
            CONCAT(mem.first_name, " ", IFNULL(mem.last_name, "")) as `Member Name`, 
            mem.email as `Email`, 
            mem.phone as `Phone`, 
            t.date as `Issue Date:Date:100`, 
            t.due_date as `Due Date:Date:100`, 
            DATEDIFF(CURDATE(), IFNULL(t.due_date, t.date)) as `Days Overdue:Int:100`,
            (DATEDIFF(CURDATE(), IFNULL(t.due_date, t.date)) * 10) as `Fine Amount:Currency:100`
        FROM `tabLibrary Transaction` t
        JOIN `tabLibrary Member` mem ON t.library_member = mem.name
        JOIN `tabArticle` a ON t.article = a.name
        WHERE t.type = 'Issue' 
        AND t.docstatus = 1 
        AND (t.due_date < CURDATE() OR t.due_date IS NULL)
        ORDER BY DATEDIFF(CURDATE(), IFNULL(t.due_date, t.date)) DESC
